language.title: Choose your language
language.body: You can change this later in Settings.

welcome.title: Welcome to {{appName}}
welcome.body: A friendly, browser-based voice pitch training app for voice training. See your pitch in real time, set target ranges, and review recordings, right from your device.
welcome.tour: Take a quick tour to get set up. It only takes a minute. ✨

notMedical.title: {{appName}} is not a medical tool
notMedical.body1: <0>{{appName}}</0> does <1>not</1> diagnose, treat, or replace professional voice therapy. Please use it alongside qualified instruction from a speech-language therapist or voice coach experienced in trans voice training.
notMedical.body2: Practicing without proper guidance can cause vocal strain or injury. 💛
notMedical.checkbox: I understand that {{appName}} is a practice aid, not medical advice, and I should work with a qualified voice professional.

pitch.title: Real-time pitch detection
pitch.body: Watch your pitch live on a scrolling timeline.

ranges.title: Voice range targets
ranges.body: Pick a preset range or define your own. See instantly whether you're in, above, or below it.

recording.title: Recording & playback
recording.body: Record practice takes and review them with full pitch visualization.

practice.title: Detail mode
practice.body: Built-in tongue twisters, add custom prompts, optional auto-advance and shuffle.

journal.title: Session journal
journal.body: Save named sessions in your browser. Backup the whole journal as a ZIP.

offline.title: Works offline
offline.body: Install {{appName}} to your home screen and use it everywhere. We'll show you how.

detail.title: Detail mode
detail.body: Practice short prompts and tongue twisters one at a time. Tap or use the arrows to move on, or turn on shuffle and auto-advance.

reading.title: Reading mode
reading.body: Read longer texts teleprompter-style. Use your own texts or pick from the built-in library.

feedback.title: Live feedback
feedback.body: A soft glow around the text shows when your pitch drifts: warm when you're above your target range, cool when below. In Reading mode you can tune the goal and threshold.

range.title: 🎯 Pick a starting range
range.intro: These are target frequency ranges commonly used in voice training, not statements about identity. Pick whatever you'd like to practice toward. You can change it any time.
range.feedbackGoalIntro: Choose which boundary the live feedback reacts to.
range.later: You can also change this later on in the Settings.

privacy.title: Your data stays with you

items.indexeddb: 🎵 Recordings and pitch samples live in your browser's storage. Nothing leaves your device.
items.exports: 📦 Exports are ZIP files you download yourself. They're yours entirely.
items.hosting: 🌐 The app is hosted on GitHub Pages. GitHub itself may log basic request info (IP, browser); the maintainer doesn't see it.
items.noTracking: 🚫 No accounts, no analytics, no cookies, no tracking.

privacy.footer: See the full <0>privacy notice</0> and <1>imprint</1> for details.

install.title: Install {{appName}} to your device
install.body: Installing makes {{appName}} feel like an app and lets it work offline. It's optional. You can always use it in the browser tab.

stepsAndroid.1: Tap "Install app" or "Add to Home Screen"

stepsIos.0: Tap the Share button (⬆️) at the bottom of Safari
stepsIos.1: Scroll and tap "Add to Home Screen"

stepsDesktopSafari.0: In Safari, choose File → "Add to Dock"

install.iosOtherBrowser: ℹ️ On iPhone & iPad, only Safari can install web apps. Open this page in Safari, then come back to this step.
install.desktopFirefox: 🦊 Firefox on desktop doesn't support PWA install. Use Chrome or Edge to install, or just bookmark this page.
install.fallback: 🔗 Open step-by-step install guide for your device
install.unknown: We couldn't detect your browser automatically. Use the install guide below for tailored steps.

done.title: You're all set
done.body: Have fun practicing. Be kind to your voice: short, regular sessions beat long, strained ones. 💛
done.revisit: You can revisit this tour any time from the About page.

about.title: About · {{appName}}
about.heading: 🎙️ About {{appName}}
about.intro: {{appName}} is an open-source, browser-based voice pitch training app for voice training. It runs entirely in your browser: no account, no server, no tracking.
about.notMedicalBody: {{appName}} does not diagnose, treat, or replace professional voice therapy. Please use it alongside qualified instruction from a speech-language therapist or voice coach experienced in trans voice training. Practicing without proper guidance can cause vocal strain or injury.
about.feature3: 🔴 Recording with playback and pitch scrub
about.feature4: 🗣️ Detail mode with auto-advance and shuffle
about.feature6: 📱 Installable as a Progressive Web App
about.dataItem3: Microphone audio is processed in your browser only.
about.dataItem4: The site is hosted on GitHub Pages.
about.restartBody: Want to walk through the intro again?

imprint.title: Imprint · {{appName}}
imprint.heading: Imprint
imprint.intro: {{appName}} is a non-commercial, open-source project. It does not serve commercial content, does not run ads, and does not collect or transmit user data.
imprint.hostingValue: GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc., 88 Colin P. Kelly Jr. St., San Francisco, CA 94107, USA)
imprint.responsible: Responsible for content: see Maintainer above.

privacy.title: Privacy · {{appName}}
privacy.heading: Privacy notice
privacy.section1Body: Nothing. {{appName}} has no backend, no analytics, no cookies, and no user accounts. The maintainer receives no data about you. The hosting provider (GitHub Pages) may log basic request data (see section 3).
privacy.section2Item1: <0>IndexedDB</0>: recordings and pitch samples under the database key <1>pitchtrain-journal</1>.
privacy.section2Item3: <0>Microphone audio</0>: processed in your browser only. It never leaves your device unless you choose to export it.
privacy.section3Body1: <0>GitHub Pages</0> hosts the static site. When your browser fetches the page, GitHub may log your IP address, user-agent, and request URL according to GitHub's privacy statement: <1>GitHub General Privacy Statement</1>. The maintainer of {{appName}} has no access to those logs.
privacy.section3Body2: <0>installpwa.com</0>: only loaded if you click the install help link during the welcome tour. Their own privacy policy applies if you visit their site.
privacy.section4Body: {{appName}} requests microphone access to detect pitch in real time. Audio is analyzed in your browser only and is not transmitted anywhere. Recordings you choose to save are stored locally in IndexedDB.
privacy.section5Body1: Because the maintainer holds no personal data about you, requests for access, correction, or deletion cannot be fulfilled by us: we simply have nothing on file. To remove all local {{appName}} data: clear your browser's site data for this domain, or uninstall the PWA.
privacy.section5Body2: For requests concerning the hosting provider's logs, please refer to GitHub's privacy statement linked above.
privacy.section7Body: This notice may be updated. The "last updated" date above reflects the most recent change.
